description: Frozen scientific criteria V2 for the I3.4.1 pinned-model executive experiment. Restores the correct IG/DG/TR decomposition from I3.2.2. V1 is superseded; it used max(0, optimal - realized) as DG, which is actually TR. These thresholds are fixed before any held-out model evaluation.
claim_boundary: The central scientific question is whether the same pinned AI model makes better executive decisions when exposed to structured cognitive state. This is a question about executive decision quality (DG), not merely whether the state contains information (IG) or whether end-to-end regret improves (TR).

supersedes.reason: V1 conflated DG and TR by using max(0, optimal_utility - realized_utility) as DG.

definitions.V_L_star: Latent optimal value: V_L^*(s) = optimal value from the full latent state.
definitions.V_O_M: Observable optimal value: V_O^M(B_M(s)) = optimal value available from observable information under condition M.
definitions.V_pi_M: Controller value: V_π^M(s) = realized value from controller π under condition M.
definitions.no_clamping: Individual task contributions to IG or DG are NOT clamped. Non-negativity holds only at the information-class expectation level.

primary_hypothesis.statement: The pinned model produces lower decision gap under the state-aware condition than under the state-blind condition: DG_aware < DG_blind.

representation_advantage.interpretation: The state-aware representation contains more useful information than the state-blind representation.
representation_advantage.note: This is a property of the observation mask, not of the model. It should hold by construction if the mask reveals more cognitive state.

information_without_exploitation.interpretation: State contains useful information, but the model executive does not exploit it effectively.
information_without_exploitation.note: This is still a scientifically useful result. Do not manufacture a success from TR.

executive_exploitation.interpretation: The same model makes better executive decisions because of the observable cognitive state.
executive_exploitation.note: This is the primary scientific claim.

control_efficiency.condition: ΔDG > 0 AND ΔTR > 0 AND cost_aware ≤ cost_blind
control_efficiency.interpretation: Structured cognitive state improves end-to-end control efficiency.
control_efficiency.note: Stronger than executive_exploitation. Requires cost efficiency in addition to decision quality.

prohibition_on_substitution: No scientific report may substitute TR for DG. TR = IG + DG, so if ΔIG > 0, then ΔTR > 0 does not imply ΔDG > 0. Reporting ΔTR as evidence of executive exploitation is prohibited.

statistical_plan.paired_design: Blind and aware conditions share the same tasks. For each task i: d_i = DG_blind,i - DG_aware,i.
statistical_plan.primary_test: Paired bootstrap on per-task DG differences.

bootstrap.note: Do NOT bootstrap individual transitions as independent observations. Resample at the task level.

primary_success_criterion.description: The lower bound of the 95% paired bootstrap CI of ΔDG must be strictly positive.

topology_grouping.method: Group tasks by topology depth band (DEPTH_1, DEPTH_4_PLUS). Report both task-level and topology-level aggregates.
topology_grouping.note: Treat topology as a grouping variable, not a covariate for post-hoc adjustment.

topology_cluster_bootstrap.note: For HELD_OUT_STRUCTURE: resample topology clusters (51 clusters), not individual tasks (150 tasks). Preserve blind/aware pairing within each selected cluster. This is the primary inferential CI for structural-generalization claims.

multiple_comparisons.note: Applied only to the exploratory ablation family, not to the primary blind-vs-aware comparison.

evaluation_order.note: Each phase must be evaluated and reported before proceeding to the next. Results from earlier phases inform whether later phases are warranted. No configuration changes between phases.

ablation_policy.purpose: Attribute executive improvement to specific cognitive-state components by computing IG_M and DG_M for each ablation.

interpretation.ig_increase: Removing a state component raises IG → the representation lost useful information.
interpretation.dg_increase_beyond_ig: Removing a component raises DG beyond what IG explains → that component helped the model make decisions.

ablation_policy.note: Ablations are exploratory. Apply Bonferroni correction to the ablation family. Ablations do not change the primary claim threshold.

claim_restrictions: No HARD or TIE difficulty claims are possible (zero tasks in held-out structure).
DEPTH_1 claims are topology generalization within the same horizon class.
DEPTH_4_PLUS claims are topology+horizon extrapolation and must be reported separately.
Do not pool DEPTH_1 and DEPTH_4_PLUS into a single structural claim.
Structural-generalization claims must use topology-cluster bootstrap as the primary CI.
Report both task-level descriptive CI and topology-cluster inferential CI for structural results.

repetition_policy.nondeterminism_probe: Before scientific evaluation, run a development repeatability probe with identical packets under identical settings.
repetition_policy.if_deterministic: Retain 1 call per task per condition.
repetition_policy.if_nondeterministic: Activate 3-5 repetitions and freeze that count before validation. V_π,i = (1/R) Σ V_π,i,r. Aggregate repetitions within a task before bootstrapping tasks.
repetition_policy.note: Never decide repetition count after held-out performance is visible.

replay_requirements.model_output_reproducibility: Store raw model outputs (raw_output, system_fingerprint, finish_reason) per step. Replay requires the same prompt, packet, and generation settings.
replay_requirements.evaluation_reproducibility: Given the same parsed action, the trajectory and scoring must be exactly reproducible using the deterministic policy/executor/oracle infrastructure.
replay_requirements.separation: Model-output nondeterminism is distinguished from deterministic evaluation replay. A failed model-output replay does not invalidate evaluation replay.
replay_requirements.identity_check: TR = IG + DG must hold for every task contribution within tolerance 1e-9.

reporting_requirements.task_level: Report paired DG, IG, TR differences and costs per task.
reporting_requirements.topology_level: Report DG, IG, TR, and success rates grouped by DEPTH_1 and DEPTH_4_PLUS.
reporting_requirements.condition_level: Report aggregate IG, DG, TR for STATE_BLIND_CONTROLLER and STATE_AWARE_CONTROLLER.
reporting_requirements.structural_limitations: Explicitly state the EASY/MEDIUM composition and the absence of HARD/TIE tasks in every structural claim.
reporting_requirements.development_metrics: Report model valid-action rate, malformed-output rate, latency, and token usage as development metrics, NOT as scientific conclusions.
reporting_requirements.claim_boundary: State explicitly which distinct claim is supported: representation_advantage, information_without_exploitation, executive_exploitation, or control_efficiency.
reporting_requirements.no_tr_substitution: Never report ΔTR as evidence of executive exploitation without also reporting ΔDG.

validity_gates.void_vs_fail: Any hard-gate failure makes the scientific run VOID, not FAIL. FAIL means a valid experiment whose hypothesis was unsupported.

prohibition: These thresholds, statistical tests, grouping variables, claim boundaries, and validity gates must not be modified after any held-out model evaluation has been run. Any change constitutes a new experiment identity.
